description: DAO treasury report, monthly: buy it in one x402 payment. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (POST /buy/dao-report, $99 in one payment), with the response schema and an example; POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. A free check first: POST the same body to /buy/dao-report/check (email required).

address.description: optional treasury address if you have no Snapshot space

email.description: optional: where to send the files too; without it they are on the order status page

space.description: your Snapshot space id, e.g. yourdao.eth

name: buy_dao_report
